semantic.justification: Task4XSBZ5 implements the native document-bound ScViewData cursor subset, with actual borrowed ScDocument and ScMarkData. Per-sheet ScViewDataTable fields start at zero, old-cursor validity starts false, active pane starts SC_SPLIT_BOTTOMLEFT. SetTabNo keeps native ValidTab guard and lazily creates only the requested slot, independently of selected-sheet marks. Cursor accessors, old-cursor fallback/reset and absent-tab sentinel follow source. Coordinate setters retain caller validity preconditions rather than inventing clamping. JS GC replaces physical per-table ownership only; no cell data, document projection, allocator or window service is created. Header declarations are reexported from the TypeScript implementation as existing Calc boundaries do. Geometry,hidden/alternate sheet-view,zoom/window/configuration services are outside this cursor subset. Task77 adds normal unmerged local-reference mouse input using actual ScInputHandler selected UTF16 text,ScModule ordered dispatch,ScViewData reference start/end and ScTabView block/function-set owners. Browser formula pointing precedes Commit and preserves the edit origin;ordinary cell dragging retains the active anchor while headers move their native cursor endpoint. Shift extends;Ctrl adds/subtracts native ScMarkData/ScMultiSel selections. This is bounded source-backed foundation work,not full Calc parity. Merged cells,fill/transfer/move,protected/alternate/split views,reference dialogs,external/3D/matrix calculation,EditEngine and complete VCL painting remain unported.
